item.title: Show HN: Outpost Go 1.4.0, a road-trip planner for the whole journey
item.summary: Hi Hacker News, Im really happy to announce a major update Outpost Go 1.4.0! This new update has a lot of features I thought were necessary for planning the perfect road trip like trip-cost planning, weather, route-aware stops, and car/RV lodging options! I would love if anyone here could try it and let me know what works, what doesn’t, or what you think is still missing. Thanks!
